items.title: The data center bottlenecks that Mavria aims to solve
items.summary:
Data center manufacturer Mavria has raised $130 million toward the company's goal of building out modular AI infrastructure.

Mavria CEO Adam Blake joins Deirdre Bosa for a discussion on how the startup is bringing an assembly-line approach to data centers.
